Vanessa —

We have a sealed physical bundle scheduled for delivery to ClientCo's vault on Tue 25 May (courier booking attached). The shipment contains the offline artifact bundle (signed_bundle.tar.gz) and the manifest (manifest_v3.json). Per your intake checklist we need to confirm the acceptance flow and who from Redwood will perform on-site or remote verification.

Questions up front:
- Will Redwood provide an on-site operator to perform signature verification and image validation, or will your team guide ClientCo's operator remotely?
- We need an explicit acceptance window (start/end) and the names and roles of everyone authorized to sign for receipt.
- Any additional verification artifacts you require beyond the manifest and signature file?

Attachments: manifest_v3.json (application/json), chain_of_custody.pdf (application/pdf)

Ian — thanks for the heads up. We can support the acceptance; see proposed plan below and callouts.

Proposed acceptance window: Tue 25 May, 09:00-12:00 local (ClientCo vault). Please confirm courier ETA and phone for the handoff.

Redwood acceptance responsibilities (high level):
- Signature verification: validate signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig against the manifest using our HSM-backed verification (we will run verification commands and share digests).
- Image validation: run the offline checksum and signature verification on the sealed bundle, then perform a smoke boot in isolated staging.
- Operator roster: onsite inspector from ClientCo must present ID + delegated acceptance letter; Redwood will provide remote engineer support.
- Evidence: we will produce an acceptance log + signed receipt (DocuSign), and retain the verification logs in the customer's audit folder.

Action items for Acme/DHL: provide precise ETA, contact at delivery, and courier manifest with AWB.

Jonas — I’m looping you and the ops team. Can you prepare the minimal runbook and the verification commands we will ask ClientCo to run? Marissa — I may need approvals on expedited onsite support if we decide to send an engineer. Hannah — please advise the temporary access/tokening steps for remote observation.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Cloud Deployments — Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: offline bundle acceptance runbook (draft)

Vanessa / Marissa / Hannah —

Draft runbook (summary):
1) Pre-delivery checks (remote, prior to courier arrival)
   - Verify manifest_v3.json checksums against our registry; command: sha256sum manifest_v3.json && cat manifest_v3.json | jq .bundle_digest
   - Verify signature: openssl dgst -sha256 -verify /etc/redwood/hsm/public.pem -signature signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig signed_bundle.tar.gz
2) Onsite handoff (ClientCo operations present)
   - Confirm recipient identity + delegation letter (photocopy into acceptance log)
   - Witness courier seal break and record seal ID in log
3) Staging validation (isolated network)
   - Mount bundle on isolated host, verify manifests, run smoke script (smoke-validate.sh) — no network egress allowed
   - Capture logs and append to acceptance record; store hashes in the audit Drive folder
4) Signoff and evidence collection
   - DocuSign acceptance form (use ClientCo template)
   - Upload signed receipt and verification logs to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClientCoAcceptance

Operator/access notes:
- We will not transmit private keys; HSM operation will be run by Redwood remotely if requested. If ClientCo's operator runs commands, request temporary session tokens and an RBAC-limited account. Hannah — please add the exact steps for token issuance and the time-limited window.

Attachments (stubs): runbook_draft.md (text), verification_commands.txt (text)

Jonas Weber
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Priyanka / Ian —

Confirmed for today. Final operational notes and timeline:

09:15 — Courier expected to arrive; ClientCo operators Anika Rao and Mateo Alvarez to accept courier and present delegation letters and photo ID. Record courier seal ID and take photo.

Verification commands (examples we will run):

- openssl dgst -sha256 -verify /opt/keys/redwood_pub.pem -signature signed_bundle.tar.gz.sig signed_bundle.tar.gz

What we will capture in the acceptance log: timestamp, AWB, courier seal ID, recipient name + badge, signature verification output, smoke-validate.sh output (return code and hash of log file). We will then DocuSign the acceptance.

Point of contact: Vanessa Ortiz (zoom link in calendar invite), backup Jonas Weber +1 (415) 555-0198.

If courier arrival slips beyond 11:30 please notify Ian and us immediately and we will adjust the token window.

Thanks — see you on Zoom.
